title: 幽皇之女
logline: 幽皇死後一年，他的女兒帶著幽都老弱跪在三宗盟門前求收容；沈歸鶴接下她，當夜玄門長老死在房中，無傷無血。

characters.name: 包三錢
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime street informant in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: short wiry man in his forties, thin moustache, quick darting eyes, hair in a lopsided topknot with a cheap copper pin. Patched ochre and brown layered robe with mismatched embroidered trims, a bulging cloth purse and three square-holed copper coins on a red string at his belt, a wide straw hat pushed back on his head. Always half-crouched, always listening.

voice.name: Puck
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；四十多歲男聲，偏高、語速快、油滑，愛討價還價；害怕時聲音發緊、句子變短。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime street informant in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: short wiry man in his forties, thin moustache, quick darting eyes, soaked to the skin and shivering, his lopsided topknot collapsed with the cheap copper pin hanging loose, wet hair plastered to his forehead and neck. Patched ochre and brown layered robe dark and dripping with seawater, a coarse grey wool blanket wrapped around his shoulders, a bulging cloth purse and three square-holed copper coins on a red string at his belt, the wide straw hat hanging soaked down his back by its cord. Hunched over, clutching the blanket closed.

Original 2D anime street informant in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: short wiry man in his forties, thin moustache, quick darting eyes now red-rimmed and watery, nose and cheeks flushed with fever, his lopsided topknot loosened and sagging with the cheap copper pin askew. A plain off-white padded inner robe under a thick patched indigo quilt wrapped around his shoulders like a cape, a bulging cloth purse and three square-holed copper coins on a red string tied at his waist, no straw hat. Half-crouched and sniffling, still listening.

characters.name: 寂聞「怒目佛」
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime warrior monk in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: broad-shouldered man in his forties, shaved head under a tall gilded lotus crown with hanging gold bead strands, thick dark brows, fierce wide amber eyes. Layered saffron and crimson kasaya over a dark undershirt, a heavy embroidered collar with gold flame patterns, a string of dark wooden prayer beads wound three times around his left forearm. Bare-handed; when he gathers force a golden aura rises around his right palm.

voice.name: Alnilam
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；四十多歲男聲，渾厚、硬、胸腔共鳴重；句子短，說出口就不收回；動怒時不吼，字字往下壓。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime warrior monk in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: broad-shouldered man in his forties, shaved head under a tall gilded lotus crown with hanging gold bead strands, thick dark brows, fierce wide amber eyes, his face drained grey-pale with cold sweat at the temples. Layered saffron and crimson kasaya over a dark undershirt, a heavy embroidered collar with gold flame patterns, the kasaya and undershirt torn open over the left chest where a palm-sized blue-green star-shaped arrow scar glows faintly on the bare skin over his heart, no arrow and no blood, a string of dark wooden prayer beads wound three times around his left forearm. Bare-handed; no golden aura around his palms.

Original 2D anime warrior monk in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: broad-shouldered man in his forties, shaved head bare with no crown, thick dark brows, wide amber eyes gone dull and heavy-lidded, his face pale and drawn. A plain grey monk's robe loosely closed over a white undershirt, no kasaya and no embroidered collar, the loose neckline showing the edge of a blue-green star-shaped arrow scar on the skin over his heart, a string of dark wooden prayer beads wound three times around his left forearm. Bare-handed; no golden aura. His broad shoulders slump; he cannot sit straight without support.

characters.name: 姬無霜「霜夫人」
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime noblewoman in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall elegant woman who looks thirty, waist-length silver-white hair worn loose under a towering black-and-silver phoenix crown with trailing silver chains, pale face, long narrow eyes with violet shadow, a small frost-flower mark at the outer corner of her left eye, a small crescent birthmark on the back of her neck usually hidden under her hair. Black layered court robe embroidered with white frost ferns, long sweeping sleeves, a deep violet outer mantle. Unarmed. Kneels with the same dignity as she stands.

voice.name: Gacrux
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；成熟女聲，低、柔、慢，冷而有禮；跪著說話也不卑不亢，每句話都像留了半句沒說。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime noblewoman in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall elegant woman who looks thirty, waist-length silver-white hair worn loose under a towering black-and-silver phoenix crown with trailing silver chains, pale face, long narrow eyes with violet shadow, a small frost-flower mark at the outer corner of her left eye, a small crescent birthmark on the back of her neck usually hidden under her hair. Black layered court robe embroidered with white frost ferns, long sweeping sleeves, a deep violet outer mantle. A slim black lacquered bow strung with a plain black cord slung across her back, and a lidded black lacquered quiver hanging at her right hip. Stands at the head of her people with the same dignity as she kneels.

characters.name: 洛青衍
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime young envoy in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: slender youth of twenty, long dark blue-black hair half tied under a low sea-green coral crown, clear bright eyes, an open friendly face, a small crescent birthmark on the back of his neck usually hidden by his hair and collar. Sea-green and ivory layered island robe with wave-pattern embroidery and a white shell-clasp belt. Unarmed.

voice.name: Achird
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；二十歲男聲，明亮、乾淨、好奇，語速中等，帶一點海島來的客氣。

characters.name: 聶孤鐵「雕匠」
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime master smith in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: massive old man, scarred bare chest under a soot-black leather apron and a rust-red embroidered half-robe, grey hair cropped short under a burnt iron band, left eye clouded white, forearms covered in burn scars. Holds long iron forge tongs.

voice.name: Algenib
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；老年男聲，沙啞、低、慢，像被煙燻過；每個字都很重。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime master smith in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: massive old man, scarred bare chest under a soot-black leather apron and a rust-red embroidered half-robe, grey hair cropped short under a burnt iron band, left eye clouded white, forearms covered in burn scars. The back of his right hand pierced clean through by a raw, rust-crusted nail wound, dried blood streaked down his right wrist and forearm. He carries no forge tongs. Hunched over himself like a man serving a sentence.

characters.name: 沈歸鶴「白鶴先生」
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime wuxia strategist in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall slender man in his thirties, very long straight ink-black hair falling past the waist, a tall white jade crown with a single white crane-feather pin, pale calm face, narrow grey eyes. Layered white silk robe embroidered with silver cranes and cloud scrolls, very wide sleeves, a pale blue sash, one folded white paper fan held in his right hand or tucked in the sash. No other weapon. Moves slowly and never raises his voice.

voice.name: Iapetus
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；三十多歲男聲，清朗、溫和、不疾不徐，從不提高音量；越要緊的話越輕、越慢，偶爾壓住一聲咳。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime wuxia strategist in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall slender man in his thirties, very long straight ink-black hair unbound and spread loose over the pillow and his shoulders, no crown and no crane-feather pin, pale face gone grey-white with dark hollows under the eyes, narrow grey eyes closed or half-open and unfocused, dry colourless lips. A plain undyed white silk inner robe loosely closed at the collar, no embroidered outer robe, no sash, no fan and no weapon. Lies on his back without moving; his breathing is shallow and his hands rest empty at his sides.

characters.name: 玄門長老
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime Taoist elder in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: thin upright old man in his seventies, long white hair gathered under a tall dark-teal jade Taoist crown, a long white beard reaching his chest, deep-set kind eyes, age spots on his hands. Layered dark-teal and black Taoist robe embroidered with silver cloud-and-pine patterns, a white horsetail whisk resting in the crook of his left arm. Sits very straight.

voice.name: Schedar
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；七十多歲男聲，蒼老、溫厚、慢，帶一點笑意；說到戰死的師弟時聲音變輕。

characters.name: 燕迴「赤纓」
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime wild sabre fighter in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: tall muscular man in his thirties, long dark-brown hair loose and windblown under a cracked bronze crown worn crooked, stubble, a loud grin. Layered rust-brown and black robe with torn embroidered hems, the left sleeve ripped off at the shoulder, one wide curved sabre with a red tassel carried over his right shoulder. Always first through the door.

voice.name: Fenrir
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；三十多歲男聲，粗、大嗓門、爽快，語尾上揚；認真起來一下子沉下去。

characters.name: 殷無聲「啞劍」
characters.appearance: Original 2D anime mute swordsman in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: lean young man in his late twenties, long black hair tied high with a plain iron ring, pale face with a thin old scar across the left cheek, dark watchful eyes. Charcoal and slate layered robe with narrow white embroidered trim, sleeves bound tight at the wrists, one straight sword in a plain black scabbard worn across his back with the hilt above his right shoulder. Stands very still and speaks only with small hand signs.

voice.name: Sadaltager
voice.style: 標準國語，咬字清楚，台北人平常說話的語調；二十多歲男聲，低、輕（角色天生不能說話，本集沒有台詞；聲音只為角色檔完整而設）。

shot_looks.appearance: Original 2D anime mute swordsman in ornate theatrical wuxia costume: lean young man in his late twenties, black hair tied high with a plain iron ring, the tail below the ring cut off bluntly so it now ends at his shoulders, pale face with a thin old scar across the left cheek, dark watchful eyes. Charcoal and slate layered robe with narrow white embroidered trim, sleeves bound tight at the wrists, one straight sword in a plain black scabbard worn across his back with the hilt above his right shoulder. Stands very still and speaks only with small hand signs.

beats.title: 幽皇之女
beats.logline: 幽皇死後一年，他的女兒帶著幽都老弱跪在三宗盟門前求收容；沈歸鶴接下她，當夜玄門長老死在房中，無傷無血。
beats.hook: 一年前，九洲東北荒原的鑄爐前，三十六名被縛的三宗血裔依序割腕，血注入爐口；三支正箭與一支餘箭入囊的一瞬，一道黑風捲走箭囊與爐火，聶孤鐵在火光裡只抓到一截斷弦。
beats.conflict: 姬無霜領著幽都兩百老弱跪在三宗盟盟府門前，說幽都已被鬼燈君篡奪，求三宗收容。寂聞要在門前殺她絕後患，沈歸鶴當眾接下她的降書；殺她，三宗背上屠弱之名、幽都三派合流；留她，等於把幽皇的女兒放進盟府。
beats.turn: 盟內議定不讓幽都人入城，把老弱送往外海鯨背嶼安置，姬無霜謝恩時手背露出一道淡金的印痕，只有沈歸鶴看見；同夜扶瀾國商船在盟府外港靠岸，二十歲的洛青衍在船頭回望盟府燈火，頸後一點胎記被海風吹亂的長髮掩住。

cliffhanger.text: 玄門長老端坐房中已死，無傷無血，窗上釘著一截斷弦；沈歸鶴拾起弦，對寂聞說：「無歸箭回來了。」

general_payoffs: 沈歸鶴當眾接下姬無霜的降書，幽都兩百老弱免於被屠，三宗盟議定送他們去鯨背嶼。
beats.theme: 收留一個敵人的女兒，是慈悲還是把刀遞給她

high_tension.event: 盟府門前，寂聞一掌按住姬無霜頭頂要廢她，沈歸鶴以身擋在掌下接過降書；殷無聲的劍橫在兩人之間，赤纓燕迴率眾圍著幽都老弱，只等一聲令下。
high_tension.stakes: 寂聞出掌，兩百幽都老弱當場被屠，三宗背上惡名；沈歸鶴不擋，他就失去把幽都三派分開的唯一籌碼。
high_tension.consequence: 姬無霜被收容，寂聞收掌但當眾說「她若傷三宗一人，我先取你的命」；三宗盟從這一刻分成信沈歸鶴與信寂聞的兩種人。

high_tension.event: 深夜齊雲殿客房，玄門長老與沈歸鶴對弈到一半告退；包三錢送茶推門，長老端坐已死，無傷無血，窗櫺上釘著一截斷弦。
high_tension.stakes: 玄門兩位道君戰死幽皇之役後，長老是玄門最後的先天；他死，玄門失聲，三宗盟三缺一。
high_tension.consequence: 沈歸鶴認出斷弦是荒原鑄爐的弦，向寂聞說出他最怕的事：無歸箭回來了；三宗把死訊壓下，對外稱長老閉關。

beats.consequence: 幽都老弱被送往鯨背嶼，姬無霜留在盟府客院受監看；玄門長老之死被壓成閉關，無歸箭回來了這件事只有沈歸鶴、寂聞、殷無聲、包三錢四人知道。沈歸鶴決定說謊到底，寂聞決定盯他到底。

state.time: 幽皇死後一年；第1日至第2日清晨
state.knowledge: 觀眾看見無歸箭鑄成與黑風奪箭、看見姬無霜手背的金印與洛青衍頸後的胎記；角色只知道長老無傷而死、窗上有荒原鑄爐的斷弦，沈歸鶴一人看見了金印；三宗本來就知道無歸箭存在，四人知道的是箭回來了。長老其實是被抽走精元而死，不是中箭；「無歸箭回來了」是沈歸鶴的恐懼，之後成了盟內的傳言。
state.character_state: 玄門長老死；姬無霜被收容在盟府客院；幽都兩百老弱在赴鯨背嶼的船上；寂聞與沈歸鶴結下當眾的裂痕；洛青衍以扶瀾國商船隨員身分停在外港，尚未入盟。
state.evidence: 釘在窗上的斷弦（沈歸鶴收著）、姬無霜的降書、長老房中未下完的棋局。
state.carry_forward: 長老之死被對外稱閉關；鯨背嶼安置開始；沈歸鶴要查箭在誰手上，寂聞要查姬無霜。

next_logline: 鯨背嶼上的孩童一夜之間全部睡著不醒，包三錢潛入島底發現收魂陣；竹虛道人為沈歸鶴的舊傷西行，沈歸鶴咳血瞞住寂聞。

mysteries.question: 無歸箭鑄成當日是誰奪走的？
mysteries.answer: 第 8 集證實鬼燈君拿不到箭、不是主謀；第 16 集證實黑風是假死十年的褚無常。箭之後怎麼落到霜夫人手上，併入 m10 留給續期。

mysteries.question: 洛青衍是誰的兒子？
mysteries.answer: 第 6 集霜夫人從頸後胎記認出他是自己的兒子；第 11 集扶瀾舊信只證實送他出海的人是幽皇之女，他的「洛」姓是扶瀾國主照襁褓繡布上的字給的；第 23 集母親為他擋箭而死，臨死才說出父親是書院使者洛行舟，以及當年送他走的原因。

series.title: 偶的江湖
series.premise: 三宗盟一年前聯手誅殺幽皇，卻把三十六條人命鑄成的無歸箭丟了；箭回來的那天，幽皇之女跪在三宗門前求收容。
